"Create a 3D game inspired by Agentic Wars: Conquest with a new level, one new mechanic, and a fresh challenge.Build a complete, fully playable 2D browser game called PAPER WORLD ULTIMATE V3.0.

IMPORTANT:
This is a complete game development project, not a landing page, not a prototype, and not a static UI mockup. Build all screens, systems, buttons, menus, gameplay mechanics, AI opponents, maps, shops, rewards and save systems.

GAME CONFIGURATION:
- Game type: 2D Territory Capture Arcade.
- Camera: Top-down.
- Opponents: AI bots only.
- Orientation: Landscape preferred, responsive to mobile and desktop.
- Visual style: Colorful, clean, smooth 2D graphics.
- Theme: Modern arcade game.
- Target: Web browsers, Android phones and tablets.
- Single-player offline gameplay.

====================================
1. MAIN MENU
====================================

Create a professional animated main menu.

Background:
- Animated colorful square characters.
- Moving territory patterns.
- Floating geometric particles.
- Smooth transitions.

Header:
- PAPER WORLD logo.
- Player avatar.
- Username.
- Player level.
- XP progress bar.
- Coin balance.
- Settings icon.

Main buttons:
- PLAY.
- MAP SELECT.
- GAME MODES.
- SHOP.
- SKINS.
- MISSIONS.
- DAILY REWARDS.
- LEADERBOARD.
- PROFILE.
- SETTINGS.

All buttons must open their corresponding functional screens.

====================================
2. PLAYER PROFILE
====================================

Create a profile screen containing:
- Player avatar.
- Editable username.
- Player level.
- XP progress.
- Total matches.
- Total wins.
- Total losses.
- Total territory captured.
- Total eliminations.
- Highest territory percentage.
- Favorite skin.
- Achievement badges.

Save profile data locally.

====================================
3. GAME MODES
====================================

CLASSIC:
Capture territory and compete against 8 AI opponents.

TIME ATTACK:
Capture as much territory as possible within 3 minutes.

SURVIVAL:
Survive against AI opponents that become more challenging over time.

PRACTICE:
Play against 2 easy AI bots.

HARDCORE:
Compete against 8 expert AI opponents.

Each mode must have a working start button and appropriate gameplay rules.

====================================
4. MAP SELECT SYSTEM
====================================

Create 10 unique playable maps.

MAP 1: CLASSIC ARENA
- Standard square grid.
- Colorful territories.
- Balanced starting positions.

MAP 2: NEON CITY
- Dark background.
- Neon grid.
- Glowing colored trails.

MAP 3: DESERT WORLD
- Warm sandy background.
- Orange and yellow visual theme.

MAP 4: ICE KINGDOM
- Light blue background.
- Frozen visual effects.

MAP 5: FOREST WORLD
- Green background.
- Nature-inspired decorative elements.

MAP 6: SPACE ARENA
- Dark space background.
- Stars and galaxy effects.

MAP 7: CANDY LAND
- Bright pastel colors.
- Candy-inspired visual theme.

MAP 8: VOLCANO
- Red and orange background.
- Volcanic decorative elements.

MAP 9: CYBER WORLD
- Futuristic purple and blue grid.

MAP 10: GOLDEN KINGDOM
- Gold and black visual theme.

MAP SELECT UI:
- Map preview image.
- Map name.
- Map description.
- Unlock requirement.
- Select button.
- Locked map indicator.
- Selected map indicator.

Maps must be visually distinct and actually usable in gameplay. Maps should use the same fair territory capture mechanics.

====================================
5. SHOP SYSTEM
====================================

Create a complete in-game shop.

SHOP CATEGORIES:

A. CHARACTER SKINS
- Classic.
- Red.
- Blue.
- Green.
- Yellow.
- Purple.
- Rainbow.
- Fire.
- Ice.
- Galaxy.
- Gold.
- Diamond.
- Shadow.
- Neon.
- Crystal.
- Lava.
- Cyber.
- Ocean.
- Candy.
- Royal.

B. TRAIL EFFECTS
- Default Trail.
- Rainbow Trail.
- Fire Trail.
- Ice Trail.
- Neon Trail.
- Galaxy Trail.
- Lightning Trail.
- Golden Trail.

C. DEATH EFFECTS
- Star Explosion.
- Color Explosion.
- Pixel Explosion.
- Rainbow Explosion.
- Bubble Explosion.

D. AVATARS

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Objective
- Build a complete, fully playable 2D browser game called PAPER WORLD ULTIMATE V3.0 with menus, AI gameplay, maps, progression, shop, missions, rewards, leaderboard, profile, and local saves.

## Requirements
- 2D top-down territory-capture arcade for browsers and mobile.
- AI-only opponents with Classic, Time Attack, Survival, Practice, and Hardcore modes.
- 10 distinct usable maps with unlock and selection states.
- Functional shop categories for skins, trails, death effects, and avatars.
- Functional profile, missions, daily rewards, leaderboard, settings, and local save data.
- Modern animated main menu and responsive landscape-oriented interface.
- Complete gameplay rather than a static mockup or prototype.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a single self-contained browser app in `index.html`.
- Used Canvas for the playable territory arena and HTML/CSS for menus.
- Added keyboard, arrow controls, touch controls, and swipe movement.
- Added a paper-dash mechanic with cooldown.
- Used LocalStorage for persistent profile and inventory data.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the responsive animated main menu and header.
- Built navigation for all requested screens.
- Built profile editing and local statistics.
- Built five game modes with differing bot counts and difficulty.
- Built 10 visually distinct maps with selection and unlock logic.
- Built shop categories and purchase/equip behavior.
- Built missions, daily rewards, leaderboard, and settings screens.
- Implemented Canvas gameplay with territory claiming, AI movement, trails, collisions, deaths, respawning, pause, replay, and match results.
- Implemented survival lives, escalating difficulty, time limits, dash mechanics, XP, coins, wins, losses, and map unlock progression.
- Verified JavaScript syntax with `node --check /tmp/opencode/paper.js`.

### Active
- Browser visual verification and gameplay testing were started but not summarized as completed.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Open `http://localhost:3002` and verify the main menu visually.
2. Test navigation, map selection, shop purchases/equipment, profile editing, and settings.
3. Start and play several modes to verify AI, territory capture, endings, rewards, and resume behavior.
4. Take a small JPEG screenshot and inspect it, replacing or correcting visible UI issues if found.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Complete implementation for the game.
- `/tmp/opencode/paper.js`: Extracted JavaScript copy used for syntax checking.

## Important Context
- The app is served through a local server on port `3002`.
- Save data is stored under the LocalStorage key `paperWorldSave`.
- The game currently contains the main implementation and has not yet had final browser screenshot or interaction verification recorded.
